caption: The drawing depicts a quilt design on a pale cream or off-white background. The central area features a large six-pointed star composed of small diamond shapes in alternating colors: red, yellow, light pink, light blue, orange, and teal. Surrounding the central star are additional diamond and triangular shapes formed from the same palette of colored diamonds, arranged symmetrically. The border on two adjacent sides, the right and bottom, showcases a decorative floral and vine pattern with green leaves, red and pink flowers, and connecting green stems, all on a matching cream background. The very edge of the quilt is bordered with a thin strip of alternating small red and white triangles. The whole composition is rectangular and set against a plain, unadorned light background. There is a small handwritten note in the lower right corner that includes the words "CORNELIUS McFRAZIER DEL. 78."
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
